purpose: Machine-readable, evidence-based capability status. A declared capability is not considered implemented unless its status and evidence say so.

capabilities.name: Authenticated MCP protocol handshake

evidence.label: Production handshake and tool-call smoke test

limitations: Uses a static bearer token; no OAuth authorization-code/PKCE server is implemented.

capabilities.name: MCP tools/list and tools/call

evidence.label: Production smoke test with expected public fixture text

limitations: Only the two listed tools are exposed.

capabilities.name: Public HTML/page text extraction

evidence.label: Production MCP reader smoke test; expected Example Domain text found

limitations: One stable public fixture was verified; extraction quality across arbitrary sites is not established.

capabilities.name: Reject non-web file: URL scheme
inputs: file:///etc/passwd as a non-networked rejection fixture
limitations: This does not prove protection against private DNS answers, redirects to private addresses, DNS rebinding, or every URL canonicalization trick.

capabilities.name: SSRF, redirect and DNS-rebinding safety coverage
limitations: Basic URL restrictions, request limits and timeouts exist, and a file: scheme rejection passed; full DNS answer validation, redirect-to-private protection, DNS rebinding prevention, and response-size abuse protections have not been proven against the live implementation.

capabilities.name: Selectable-text PDF extraction

evidence.label: Production synthetic two-page PDF test found both unique page text markers

limitations: The synthetic two-page fixture returned both unique text markers; page-by-page response structure, real-world layout, tables, encrypted files, scanned pages, and large-document support remain unverified.

capabilities.name: Reject malformed PDF uploads

evidence.label: Production PDF input validation (two-page read, malformed PDF and non-PDF rejection)

limitations: The tested malformed synthetic PDF was rejected with a client error; broader corrupt/encrypted/polyglot input cases remain untested.

capabilities.name: Reject non-PDF uploads on PDF endpoint

evidence.label: Production PDF input validation (two-page read, malformed PDF and non-PDF rejection)

limitations: A text/plain upload was rejected with a client error; MIME/extension spoofing and other unsupported-type combinations remain untested.

capabilities.name: OCR for scanned/image-only PDFs
limitations: No working OCR provider/path has been integrated and tested.

capabilities.name: DOCX, PPTX, XLSX and CSV readers
outputs: Ordered paragraphs, slides, sheets, cells and tables
limitations: No production Office reader has been verified.

capabilities.name: OCR for images and screenshots
limitations: No production OCR engine/provider has been integrated and tested.

capabilities.name: Visual understanding of charts, diagrams and UI screenshots
limitations: No dedicated image-understanding adapter has been integrated into this app.

capabilities.name: Audio transcription
inputs: Supported audio file or authorized URL
limitations: No working transcription provider/path has been integrated and tested.

capabilities.name: Video captions/transcription and Arabic translation
inputs: Video URL or supported video file
limitations: No end-to-end video acquisition, transcription, translation, or SRT/VTT export has been tested.

capabilities.name: JavaScript-rendered browser runtime
capabilities.blocker: A supported headless browser runtime has not been confirmed in the current Floot environment.
limitations: The public text reader is not equivalent to a full browser engine.

capabilities.name: Remote DOM inspection and browser automation
capabilities.blocker: No supported secure remote-browser runtime is deployed or connected.
limitations: Do not claim remote clicking, form filling, or browser control.

capabilities.name: Local tab/history/bookmark persistence
outputs: Local restore and bounded local snapshot
limitations: Partial Floot source edits exist but UI wiring, typecheck, tests and publication have not been verified.

capabilities.name: Durable server-side workspace persistence
limitations: No persistent storage implementation is connected to the published app.

capabilities.name: Compatible VS Code/Copilot MCP configuration
limitations: Configuration is validated, but a real user-side VS Code/Copilot session has not been tested here.

capabilities.name: Direct custom MCP connection from ChatGPT Android Free

evidence.label: Official OpenAI custom MCP server availability documentation

capabilities.blocker: Current official documentation says custom MCP server connections are web-only and plan-limited; the current Free Android session cannot directly attach this custom MCP server.
limitations: Do not claim this ChatGPT Android conversation is directly connected to CHRONO CROSS GPT.

capabilities.name: Bounded UTF-8, Markdown, CSV and JSON file readers (repository adapter)
inputs: Uploaded UTF-8 text, Markdown, CSV and JSON bytes
limitations: Reader module is implemented in the repository and has an offline regression suite, but it is not wired into the published Floot UI/MCP endpoint or a deployed bridge.
DOCX/PPTX/XLSX, PDF OCR, images, audio/video, and archive formats are not handled by this adapter.
Input is limited to 1 MiB by default; CSV row/column/cell limits and JSON nesting/node limits are enforced.
